pattern: と相まって（とあいまって）
purpose: Describe two factors combining to create a stronger effect.
keywords: N + と相まって; N + が相まって
The lighting combined with the music to create a dreamlike space.
Effort combined with talent to produce results.
The sea breeze and shade together keep the garden cool.
formation: N + と相まって; N + が相まって
restrictions: Both factors contribute jointly to the result.
mistake: It implies interaction or reinforcement, not an unrelated list.
